experiment_name: DDQN resume from 20-game milestone to 500 total games (CPU, seed 42)

algorithm_config.resumed_from: 20-game milestone checkpoint (SHA-256 47f3c177c1ae42449b8b3d1a34c253204329e15240a6345d78412f4f900716f4), preserved separately at artifacts/training_smoke/milestones/ddqn_hybrid_20_v2_milestone.pt before this run

result: 500/500 games completed (480 this run + 20 resumed), no crash, no interruption, no illegal action. Win rate stayed 0.0% in every logged window; epsilon only decayed to ~0.78, still early relative to the trainer's 0.9995/game decay toward a 0.05 floor (the paper's own reference run used 10,000 games). This checkpoint's actual strength vs. the 20-game one is measured separately in 005 - do not infer strength from this entry alone.
notes: integrity.fallbacks is null because the DDQN training loop's history schema does not expose a fallback counter for the fixed opponents it trains against (same gap as 002). RAM was rechecked before launch (3.49 GiB available, above the 2 GiB default floor) and this run completed with the default memory-watchdog thresholds, unlike the reproducibility-check attempts in 003.
